module: Flowgraph node "Audio Fade Out" (category once_f_duration, tags sound/audio/volume). Brings the global volume down to silence: sets g_FadeTimeMS (= duration in ms) and g_GameLoading = 1 via SFXSystem.setGlobalParameter, then waits for the duration to signal completion. Input: duration (s, default 1).
notes: Mirror of Audio Fade In (g_GameLoading = 0 there). When the node stops or resets, both parameters are set back to 0, which cancels the fade.

_executionStopped.desc: Calls reset() when the graph stops.

onNodeReset.desc: Calls reset() when the node is reset.

reset.desc: Sets the timer back to 0, the duration state to 'inactive' and g_FadeTimeMS / g_GameLoading to 0.

workOnce.desc: On the first flow: g_FadeTimeMS = duration*1000, g_GameLoading = 1, state 'started'.

work.desc: Every frame: advances the timer (mgr.dtReal) and sets the state to 'finished' once duration is reached.
